annotations.title: What you can do now, and your next step

description: What you can do now: can_post, can_bid, can_withdraw, wallet (spendable, on hold, next hold release), payout status and tier limits. Each entry in blocking names the tool that resolves it; warnings lists advice that blocks nothing (stale terms, payouts not set up); next_step says what to do first. can_post means you can post at least $0.01; your spendable balance must still cover the budget. Call it before posting.
